lemma: Enriched shrinkage candidate for De Morgan formulas: E[L(f|rho)] <= C*(p^2 L(f) + p*sqrt(L(f))) under uniform random restriction with keep probability p. Checked exactly at n=3 over all 256 functions with C=1 (max ratio 0.9 at p=1/8). Not proved for n>=4 and not connected to the Trevisan-Xue or switching-lemma step of LIT-8b.
gap: No proof of the candidate for general n. The LIT-8b localization step has no formula-model analogue yet. The limit E/p -> 2^(1-n) N_lit(f) is a hand derivation, not verified. Open: whether sup_f 2^(1-n) N_lit(f)/sqrt(L(f)) stays bounded in n; this needs an exact n=4 DP over 2^16 functions.
refuted_approach: Uniform-in-p form E[L(f|rho)] <= C p^2 L(f) (the shrinkage form of S-f98d479184). Refuted by parity: restricting parity_n to exactly one surviving variable gives a literal, so E >= n p (1-p)^(n-1), and E/(p^2 L) >= (1-p)^(n-1)/(p n) -> infinity as p -> 0 for fixed n. Also retracted: the premise L(XOR_K)=K^2 used in cm-a956e568509d41a8 and S-db1e6d69cb; the exact DP gives L(XOR_3)=10, not 9.
evidence: cm-52e5607b349a4978 and cm-886a02b0d9d24a1f (exact n=3 DP over all 256 functions; max L=10 at f=105; enriched candidate max ratio 0.9 at p=1/8). cm-a956e568509d41a8 is binomial arithmetic only, and its K^2 reading is retracted. Correction recorded in Q-d2c52a704c. Claim claim:5a08705d62ca is a pure binomial identity and stays valid as arithmetic; it is not a formula-model result.
